bio.text: Arthur Purves is the Republican candidate for Virginia's 11th Congressional District in 2026, challenging Democratic Rep. James Walkinshaw.
He is president of the Fairfax County Taxpayers Alliance, according to the Virginia Mercury.
He was also listed among the candidates in the June 28, 2025 Republican primary for the special election to fill the 11th District seat.
